description: Greater Sydney & Outer Metropolitan Bus Service Performance Data is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This dataset provides monthly measures for on-time running, service cancellations, customer complaints, and customer experience metrics across all Greater Sydney Bus Contract (GSBC) and Outer Sydney Metropolitan Bus Contract (OSMBSC) contracts. Data Description: Monthly % Bus Service Cancellations: Percentage of timetabled services that were cancelled at the First Transit Stop of a trip. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are bus, bus running results, buses. It offers 2 resource(s) in VISUALISATION, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
